testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.integration.queue.workflow.AmqpWorkflowQueueTests

testcase.name: a published job is delivered once with delivery count 1 and its body intact()
a message that keeps coming back unacknowledged is dead-lettered by the delivery limit and does not loop()
nack without requeue dead-letters exactly that message and it never returns to the main queue()
a message whose consumer died before the ack is delivered again with a higher count()
a publish the broker refuses is reported as a failure and not lost silently - publisher confirm failure()
a publish to a queue that does not exist is refused as unroutable instead of vanishing()
a consumer that dies before the ack gets the message redelivered and the effect still happens once()
a lease from a channel that died is stale - acknowledging it is a no-op and the message comes back, a reused delivery tag harms nobody()
the topology is a durable quorum queue with a dead-letter exchange and a delivery limit, and declaring it twice changes nothing()
a publish is confirmed by the broker and survives, and the message is persistent()
a poison run reaches the real dead-letter queue after its budget, healthy runs are unaffected, and nothing is requeued()
messages survive a broker restart and a lease from before it is stale()
a workflow runs to the end through the real broker, and duplicate deliveries repeat no effect()
